title: INC-2019-06-24: Verizon route leak took parts of the network offline

props.title: Verizon route leak took parts of the network offline
props.summary: Eight days before 2 July 2019. Routes leaked by another network were accepted by Verizon. Not a Cloudflare change. The time of day is not recorded here.
